title: Add a PaceCalculator regression test for bulkBaseline exceeding totalItems
why: pace_calculator.dart's class doc explicitly documents 'Clamped to 0 when bulkBaseline > totalItems (over-marked prior learning)' as a named edge case, but no test in the file constructs bulkBaseline > totalItems (test 6 only reaches bulkBaseline == totalItems, which is 0 without needing the clamp). A real scenario producing this — a curriculum's content set shrinks after a user already bulk-marked more items than now exist — would silently regress to a negative requiredVelocity (and a nonsensical paceStatus) if the .clamp(0.0, double.infinity) at pace_calculator.dart:150 were ever narrowed or removed, with nothing in the suite to catch it.
recommendation: Add a test with totalItems < bulkBaseline (e.g. totalItems: 50, bulkBaseline: 80) asserting requiredVelocity == 0.0 and paceStatus is never ahead/behind.
acceptance_criteria: New test fails red if pace_calculator.dart:150's .clamp(0.0, double.infinity) is changed to allow negative values.
